description: This file is a PHP class defining the Customer controller for the OpenCart admin interface. It manages customer-related operations such as listing, editing, creating, deleting, enabling/disabling, authentication, and handling customer data, including transactions, awards, IP addresses, authorizations, and related functionalities.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer operations in the OpenCart admin interface, handling CRUD operations, customer data, and related functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the customer list page with filters and links.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the customer list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Builds and returns the customer list HTML page.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the customer form for adding or editing customer data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving customer data, including validation and updating database.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks customer login attempts.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected customers.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected customers.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected customers.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Allows admin to simulate customer login.

methods.name: payment
methods.description: Displays payment method proxies for a customer.

methods.name: getPayment
methods.description: Retrieves and displays customer's payment subscriptions.

methods.name: deletePayment
methods.description: Deletes a specific customer payment subscription.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays customer history.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves customer history for display.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds an entry to customer history.

methods.name: transaction
methods.description: Displays customer transactions.

methods.name: getTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves and displays transaction data for a customer.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Adds a transaction record for a customer.

methods.name: reward
methods.description: Displays customer rewards.

methods.name: getReward
methods.description: Retrieves and shows customer reward points.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Adds reward points for a customer.

methods.name: ip
methods.description: Displays IP addresses associated with a customer.

methods.name: getIp
methods.description: Retrieves and displays IP data for a customer.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Displays authorization records for a customer.

methods.name: getAuthorize
methods.description: Retrieves customer authorizations.

methods.name: deleteAuthorize
methods.description: Deletes a customer authorization.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides customer data for autocomplete feature.

methods.name: customfield
methods.description: Retrieves custom fields for customer groups.
